card.name: Pill counts before strength in dosing tables
card.fires_on: The spot right after a pill count or frequency number (such as 3, 4, 2 or "×") in dose schedules, just before the strength (e.g. 200 mg) or a following number. It also fires on "day" or "as" in split-dose wording.

modes.label: Count then strength
modes.description: Space or multiplication sign after a number of tablets, right before the mg strength of each tablet.

modes.label: Dose tables
modes.description: Gap after a digit in a weight-band dosing table, before the next digit or column.

modes.label: Divided-dose wording
modes.description: Linking word in text describing how a daily total is split into doses.
modes.example: is 1200 mg per day, administered<< as>> 600 mg twice daily.

card.plain: It marks the point in a dose schedule where a number of tablets is about to be followed by their strength or the next figure.
